build_continuous_transformer_wrapper: build a ContinuousTransformerWrapper with AttentionLayers, probabilistic output for mean and variance prediction
create_autoregressive_wrapper: create a ContinuousAutoregressiveWrapper to generate continuous sequences autoregressively with KV caching
test_gaussian_nll_loss: test the GaussianNLL loss function for computing negative log-likelihood on mean and variance predictions
run_forward_rollout: run forward_rollout on ContinuousAutoregressiveWrapper with multiple rollout steps for world model training
sample_from_mean_variance: sample from a mean and variance distribution using sample_from_mean with configurable temperature
